assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a completely new ultra-wide cinematic landscape artwork for the full-screen hero of an academic research website. Create an awe-inspiring, majestic view of a living alien world billions of years in the future, at the edge of cosmic time. An impossible planet-scale ivory and bronze organic megastructure rises from a misty ocean, its kilometer-wide arching ribs forming a vast mathematically precise toroidal cathedral which sweeps across the top and right of the composition, disappearing beyond the frame. Nested logarithmic spirals, branching coral-like trabecular bone lattices, recursively finer filigree, graceful curving catenaries; fractal self-similarity at many scales. Through its huge central opening, a small distant perfectly spherical intricate organism floats over the horizon, with an ancient ringed planet barely visible through amber haze. The sense of scale must be overwhelming, with immense distances and deep atmospheric perspective, no human buildings. Extremely fine structural detail, sophisticated photoreal cinematic concept art, beautiful and unknowable, welcoming wonder rather than horror. Restrained warm ivory, antique gold, amber, oxidized bronze, smoky umber. Low amber sun and volumetric light entering from center left; deep shadowed umber foreground at bottom and left. Composition: very wide landscape 16:9, no collage; great open breathing room in left third and lower left for large cream website typography added later, most sculptural detail in right half and upper edge. Strong graceful large silhouettes, vast horizon; neither busy everywhere nor miniature. No text, no letters, no people, no watermarks, no UI, no neon, no purple. Make an original image, not a copy of any earlier reference. Highest detail available; wide 2560 by 1440 composition.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: completely new standalone transparent cutout of a mathematically intricate alien geometric organism for an academic website. One monumental, almost perfectly spherical ivory organism, composed of interwoven logarithmic spiral shells and mathematically ordered recursive, porous skeletal filigree. Its outer silhouette is a precise sphere; internally seven sweeping nautilus-like curled ivory plates open into deep shadowed bronze chambers, with delicate branching coral trabeculae and nested smaller spirals within larger spirals. The geometry feels like a living Calabi-Yau sculpture from a civilization billions of years in the future, organic yet rigorous, intricate at multiple scales; graceful curvature and subtly asymmetric golden-angle growth. Warm bone ceramic, softly luminous amber interior, fossil gold edges, tiny muted sage mineral traces. Museum-quality cinematic 3D rendering with astonishingly fine tactile detailing, dignified and mysterious, no horror. The object fills about 82 percent of a square frame with clear space around every edge, centered, three-quarter lighting from upper left, rich dimensional shadows within the object. Entirely transparent background, no ground, no cast shadow outside the object, no lettering, no border, no watermark, no other objects. Not a simple wireframe ball; substantial sculptural depth and fine organic ornament.
